Definition
[Rarefaction curve] ↗ def:eigenvalue-eigenvector-notation-hyperbolic 1. ch11:11.2-def-1\group Conservation Laws

Given a fixed state $z_0\in \mathbb {R}^m$, we define the $k^{\text{th}}$-rarefaction curve \[ R_k(z_0) \] to be the path in $\mathbb {R}^m$ of the solution of the ODE (6) which passes through $z_0$.

For a genuinely nonlinear pair, set \[ R_k^+(z_0)=\{ z\in R_k(z_0)\mid \lambda _k(z)>\lambda _k(z_0)\} , \qquad R_k^-(z_0)=\{ z\in R_k(z_0)\mid \lambda _k(z)<\lambda _k(z_0)\} . \] Then $R_k(z_0)=R_k^+(z_0)\cup \{ z_0\} \cup R_k^-(z_0)$.
